description: Header file defining the RenderEngineThreaded class, which extends RenderEngine to include threading capabilities for rendering operations in Android's rendering engine.

classes.name: RenderEngineThreaded
classes.description: A subclass of RenderEngine that manages rendering in a separate thread, queuing function calls for thread-safe execution.
